title: Statistics dashboard
detail: One page of network statistics, by line, branch, phase and the whole system: route-km by structure type (box, shield, TBM, sunk, viaduct, at grade), stations by access type, trains and fleet, headways, run times and average speed (scheduled and commercial), trips, boardings by station (top and bottom), peak loads, transfers, passenger-km, car-km, energy use, and cost per km by era. Sortable tables, a chart per measure, export to CSV.
